say:1:1220717001:1.text: Unbelievable! This is exactly what Gray Amber smells like!
say:1:1220717001:1.source_cn: 难以置信，这就是灰琥珀的味道！

say:3:1220717002:1.text: The top notes are still slightly off, but with a few more trials and adjustments to the ingredient ratios, it can definitely be improved.
say:3:1220717002:1.source_cn: 前调还是稍微差了点，但只要多试几次，调整原材料的配比，...

say:4:1220717003:1.text: This is a miracle! You must be sent by Dura to save me! Now my business is saved!
say:4:1220717003:1.source_cn: 这简直是神迹！你们一定是艾雅派来拯救我的使者，这下子我...

say:5:1220717004:1.text: Destiny must have led me to Rustport, so our paths would cross.
say:5:1220717004:1.source_cn: 我来锈锚港或许是神明的旨意，就是为了和你们相遇。

say:6:1220717005:1.text: Oh, you're making me blush! It was just a small favor.
say:6:1220717005:1.source_cn: 呀，你说得我都有点不好意思了！我们只是帮个小忙而已。

say:7:1220717006:1.text: Small favor? No, no dear friends... don't you see? This is a massive, unprecedented business opportunity!
say:7:1220717006:1.source_cn: 小忙？不不……亲爱的朋友，你们没看出来吗？这可是一个巨...

choice_prompt:8:1220717006.text: Small favor? No, no dear friends... don't you see? This is a massive, unprecedented business opportunity!
choice_prompt:8:1220717006.source_cn: 小忙？不不……亲爱的朋友，你们没看出来吗？这可是一个巨大的、前所未有的商机！

say:9:1220717007:1.text: Artificially manufactured Gray Amber, of course! Once this rare substance can be produced consistently...
say:9:1220717007:1.source_cn: 当然是人工制造灰琥珀！这种稀有的香料一旦能稳定产出……
say:9:1220717007:1.male: Artificially manufactured Gray Amber, of course! Once this rare substance can be produced consistently...
say:9:1220717007:1.female: Artificially manufactured Gray Amber, of course! Once this rare substance can be produced consistently...

say:10:1220717008:1.text: Dura above, I'll be the biggest perfume merchant in the Lightbearer Empire! "Tum's Touch" has a nice ring, I must say...
say:10:1220717008:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我会成为耀光帝国最大的香水商！“图姆制造”，...

choice_prompt:11:1220717008.text: Dura above, I'll be the biggest perfume merchant in the Lightbearer Empire! "Tum's Touch" has a nice ring, I must say...
choice_prompt:11:1220717008.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我会成为耀光帝国最大的香水商！“图姆制造”，听起来真是不错……

say:12:1220717009:1.text: Don't worry, I'll provide a substantial payment for the exclusive formula... as compensation for your investment in my business venture!
say:12:1220717009:1.source_cn: 当然，我会付一大笔独家配方费用……作为你们对我商业计划...

say:13:1220717010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hammie, I shall never forget your names or your generosity for as long as I live.

say:14:1220717011:1.text: Artificial Gray Amber is going to disrupt the perfume industry!
say:14:1220717011:1.source_cn: 我敢打赌，人工灰琥珀一定会成为新的香水界潮流的！

say:15:1220717012:1.text: That's great, Mr. Tum! May all your dreams come true!
say:15:1220717012:1.source_cn: 太好了，图姆先生，希望你能够梦想成真！
